name: Overlapping Despoiled Ground patches keep one aura on a target (#13078)
contract: Despoiled Ground 805180 (Cultist) is a persistent area aura with a periodic Shadow damage tick every 3 sec.
Aura::CanStackWith keeps two such ground auras of the same spell and caster from stacking on one target, and
ground auras refresh their targets every 500 ms, so with two overlapping patches each refresh replaced the
other patch's application; #13078 reports the target's aura constantly switching durations, and every
replacement restarted the 3 sec tick. Expected (approach ruled by the PR author): a target in several of the
caster's overlapping patches keeps the application it holds until that patch leaves or ends, so it is
applied once, and its ticks keep coming. No Presence is active, so no other patch can appear. Over 8 sec,
while both 12 sec patches still overlap, the target must see no new application and at least 2 ticks. Two
live patches are established without a ground effect count metric: two casts are counted, and right after
the second the oldest live patch (which dynamic_object_duration_ms reads) has at most 11 sec of its 12 sec
left, so it is still the first patch; it must also still be up when the window ends, and the second, newer
patch outlasts it. The enemy's aura must have been applied exactly once before the window, and in the window
the tick count must be 2 or 3: both patches ticking would give 4 or more.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: the first patch is accepted
SETUP: the enemy carries the first patch's aura
SETUP: the second patch is accepted
SETUP: the oldest live patch is still the first one, cast over 1.6 sec earlier
Let both patches refresh their targets
SETUP: the enemy's aura was applied once, the second patch did not replace it
SETUP: the older patch is still up, so both still overlap
#13078: the overlapping patches do not swap the enemy's aura
#13078: one held aura ticks every 3 sec (2 or 3 ticks, not both patches)
